column1: 李雪还有一年就本科毕业了，____。为了准备考试，____，还读了一些新的专业书，希望更多地了解这方面的知识。有时候她学习的时间很长，____，但是她还是坚持每天学习。随着考试的时间越来越近，李雪也更努力地复习，____，在新的学校里继续学习更多知识。|Li Xue has one year until graduation and decides to take the master's entrance exam. She reviews university courses and reads new professional books. Long study hours sometimes cause stress, but she keeps studying. As the exam approaches, she works harder, hoping for an admission letter and further study at a new school.|也会觉得有一些压力|she also feels some pressure|她除了复习大学学过的课程|besides reviewing her university courses|她决定参加硕士研究生考试|she decides to take the master's entrance exam|希望拿到研究生的入学通知书|hoping to receive a postgraduate admission letter|C B A D

小张最近换了一个比较理想的工作。由于新公司离她现在住的地方比较远，____。她在网上查找到一条出租信息，____。房东说，小张要租的房子不太大，____，房租不高，位置也比较好。接着，房东又建议小张过去看看。小张看了以后，____，就租了下来。|Xiao Zhang changes to a better job far from her present home, so she decides to rent near the company. She finds a listing online and calls the landlord. The home is small but clean, inexpensive and well located. After viewing it, she likes it and rents it.|就给房东打了电话|then called the landlord|觉得房子很不错|thought the home was very good|她决定在公司附近租个房子|she decided to rent near the company|但是很干净|but it was very clean|C A D B

在中国，用手机支付、网购和寄快递都很方便，所以很多人觉得自己快要离不开手机了。____，还不会用中国人常用的手机App，她很着急。她的中国朋友知道后，____，教她怎么用，她很快就学会用手机支付和网购了。____，不到40分钟，外卖员就把饭送来了，____。现在，她几乎每天都用手机点外卖或网购。|Mobile payments, online shopping and parcel services are convenient in China. When Aili first comes to Beijing, she cannot use common apps and feels worried. Her Chinese friend helps her, and she learns quickly. Her first takeaway arrives within forty minutes, which she finds very convenient. Now she orders food or shops online almost daily.|马上给她提供帮助|immediately helped her|爱丽觉得太方便了|Aili thought it was very convenient|第一次点外卖时|when ordering takeaway for the first time|爱丽刚来北京留学时|when Aili first came to Beijing to study|D A C B

小王今天早上起晚了，____。她坐地铁到了公司附近，想在地铁站买点儿吃的。小王选好早餐后，突然发现手机没电了，____。她正要把吃的放回去，一位乘客看到了，问她需不需要帮忙。小王把事情告诉了她，她就给小王买了一份早餐。____，一直向她说“谢谢”。小王因为这件事，____。|Xiao Wang wakes late and leaves without breakfast. Near work she chooses food at the subway station but finds her phone has no battery and cannot scan a code. Another passenger sees her difficulty and buys her breakfast. Xiao Wang thanks her repeatedly and feels happy all day.|扫不了码|could not scan the code|一天的心情都非常愉快|felt happy all day|小王非常感谢她|Xiao Wang was very grateful to her|没来得及吃早饭就去上班了|went to work without time for breakfast|D A C B

周末，白家月请大家一起吃饭，____。点菜时，白家月让大家想吃什么就点什么，并说自己很喜欢这家饭店的菜，味道特别好。王一雪建议每个人先点一个自己喜欢的菜，____。王一雪要了一个汤，李文选了一道凉菜，____，白家月最后点了一道肉菜。____，边吃边聊，非常开心。|Bai Jiayue treats everyone to a weekend meal to thank them for their care. She invites them to order whatever they like. Wang Yixue suggests one dish each first, with more if needed. Everyone orders, gathers around and enjoys talking over the meal.|不够再加|add more if it is not enough|刘明和两个孩子也各点了一道菜|Liu Ming and the two children each ordered a dish too|大家聚在一起|everyone gathered together|感谢他们这段时间对自己的照顾|to thank them for their care recently|D A B C

____，最好赶快去医院看看。第一次在中国的医院看病，可以先问护士应该怎么做。一般来说，顺序是先挂号，然后去找医生看病。要是怕听不懂医生说的话，可以找个中国朋友陪你一起去医院，____。看病时，医生会先问你哪儿不舒服，然后给你做一些检查。____，医生会给出治疗的方法。按照医生说的做，____，多休息，病就会好得更快。|This textbook passage describes seeing a doctor: if unwell, visit a hospital and ask a nurse about procedures. Register, then see the doctor. A Chinese-speaking friend can accompany you to translate. After questions and examinations, the doctor recommends treatment. The passage advises following the doctor's instructions, taking medicine on time and resting.|按时吃药|take medicine on schedule|帮你翻译|help translate for you|如果感觉身体不舒服|if you feel unwell|检查结果出来以后|after the examination results are available|C B D A

上周，小张接到经理的任务，____。她和一些客户交流了一下，____。有的客户觉得价格有点儿高，有的客户更关心产品好用不好用。昨天，小张按照客户的年龄和性别，写好了调查结果，并交给了经理，____。通过这次调查，她对客户的想法有了更多了解，____。|Last week Xiao Zhang was assigned to conduct market research at several companies. She spoke with customers about a new product: some focused on price, others on usability. She organised results by age and gender and submitted them on time. The survey increased her understanding of customers and her experience.|按时完成了任务|completed the task on time|也积累了不少经验|also gained considerable experience|去几家公司做市场调查了|went to several companies to conduct market research|了解他们对新产品的看法|to understand their views of the new product|C D A B

工作或学习时间长了就要休息一会儿，____。我以前在学校读书时，很长一段时间里，除了上课，就是在图书馆学习，____。结果是不仅学习效果不好，____。后来，我开始注意锻炼身体，____，学习效率也提高了。|Take breaks after long periods of work or study to be more efficient. The writer used to spend all their time in class or the library, even missing regular lunch. Study results were poor and colds frequent. After exercising and resting when tired, study efficiency improved.|累了就休息|rest when tired|这样效率才能更高|only this way can efficiency be higher|还经常感冒|also often caught colds|中午也不按时吃饭|did not eat lunch on time either|B D C A

去年，我刷短视频时看到有个人发了很多老照片，照片里有个女孩儿特别像我妈妈。我给妈妈看了这个视频，____，说那就是她。原来那些照片是她和她以前的好朋友小江一起拍的。她们从小一起长大，____，从此就慢慢失去了联系。我跟发视频的人联系了一下，对方马上向我要了妈妈的微信号，____。从此，她们常在网上聊天儿，好像回到了年轻时。妈妈说，____，但是她们还能联系上，而且美好的友情还在，她觉得很幸运。|The writer sees old photographs in an online video and recognises someone resembling their mother. After looking carefully, the mother confirms it is her with childhood friend Xiao Jiang. They lost contact after studying in different cities. The writer contacts the uploader, and the friends reconnect on WeChat. Despite the passing years, their friendship remains, making the mother feel lucky.|于是她们相互加了微信|so they added each other on WeChat|后来去了不同城市上大学|later went to university in different cities|尽管这么多年过去了|although so many years had passed|她看了好一会儿|she looked for quite a while|D B A C

现在，____，越来越多生活在北方，特别是东北的老年人就会到南方生活一段时间。这是因为冬天的北方比较冷，____，很暖和，特别是云南、海南的一些城市，____，很适合老年人。除了气候，在南方城市的生活和北方没有很大差别，老人平时可以去家附近的公园活动活动，____。冬天结束后，老人们才回到自己北方的家。|When winter arrives, more older people from northern China, especially the northeast, spend some time in the south. Northern winters are cold, while southern cities in Yunnan and Hainan can reach temperatures in the twenties. Daily life is otherwise similar: people visit local parks and buy fresh produce. They return north after winter.|温度能达到二十几度|temperatures can reach the twenties|而南方的气候比较好|while the southern climate is better|一到冬天|as soon as winter arrives|还可以去超市买新鲜的水果和菜等|and can buy fresh fruit and vegetables in supermarkets|C B A D
